title: TRiCopathy-registry
summary:
Brain malformations are common causes of developmental disorders or epilepsy. As part of a previous research project, we were able to identify changes in the so-called TRiC complex as the cause of congenital malformations and functional disorders of the brain. This new group of disorders, known as “TRiCopathies,” will be further investigated in this study.
A registry for this rare disease will be established to systematically document patients with TRiCopathies. This will enable better predictions regarding the course of the disease and treatment options in the future.
Since the group of TRiCopathies is very rare and was only recently discovered, we hope this study will help connect patients and their families.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
A valid molecular genetic finding confirming the presence of a variant in a gene of the TRiC complex must already be available. These findings are reviewed by the study leadership prior to inclusion in the registry.
Exclusion criteria:
No variant is present in the TRiC complex.
